channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Bid to replace glass business with flats clears first hurdle
item.description: A bid for eight flats at the site of a cherished Hampshire business has cleared the first hurdle.

item.title: Café told it cannot open on Sundays for fear of disrupting the neighbours
item.description: Planners have told a cafe owner she cannot open on Sundays due to concerns from neighbours about the noise and smell from the business.

item.title: Nursery closed for months due to water leak issues new statement
item.description: Families at YMCA Woolston Nursery have been told to prepare to wait for months while the nursery awaits a leak to be repaired and sign off from Ofsted before it can reopen.

item.title: 29 schools feature in nativity picture special in tomorrow's Daily Echo
item.description: The Daily Echo's nativity picture special supplement, featuring 29 Southampton and Hampshire schools, is out tomorrow

item.title: Why protesters gathered outside pet shop in Southampton
item.description: Protesters against the sale of animals gathered outside the Pets at Home in Southampton.

item.title: Multiple cruise ships due in Southampton before Christmas
item.description: A large number of cruise ships are scheduled to visit Southampton in the days leading up to Christmas which are expected to bring traffic to the city centre.

item.title: Gran of rape victim, 12, said its 'despicable' that man thought she was 19
item.description: The grandmother of a 12-year-old girl who was raped by a man in a Southampton hotel says it is "despicable" that he thought she was 19

item.title: Toy library dating back more than 50 years facing closure
item.description: A toy library which has provided free play to thousands of children for more than 50 years is set to close at the end of the month.

item.title: Scheme to turn shopping centre into student flats sees controversial approval
item.description: A controversial student accommodation scheme on the site of a Southampton shopping centre has been approved by the narrowest of margins at a council meeting.

item.title: 'Scum': Mum's grief after two-year-old son's grave vandalised
item.description: A Southampton mother said she was left shaking and screaming when she found that her two-year-old son's grave had been vandalised
